cases.sentence: У Вронского было еще ___ – лошади, до которых он был страстный охотник.
cases.translation: Vronsky had another occupation - horses, of which he was a passionate devotee.
cases.explain: «Занятие» is the subject complement after «было» (was), so it stands in the Nominative case.

cases.sentence: Сын отказался от предложенного ему важного для ___ положения.
cases.translation: The son had refused an important position offered to him for the sake of his career.
cases.explain: The preposition «для» (for the sake of) governs the Genitive case, hence «карьеры».

cases.sentence: Внешняя жизнь его... катилась по-прежнему, привычным ___ светских и полковых связей и интересов.
cases.translation: His outward life rolled on as before, along the familiar rails of social and regimental ties and interests.
cases.explain: The verb of motion «катилась по» (rolled along) governs the Dative plural, hence «рельсам».

cases.sentence: он любил ___, и еще более потому, что его любили в полку.
cases.translation: He loved the regiment, and even more so because he was loved in the regiment.
cases.explain: «Полк» is the direct object of «любил» (loved), so it stands in the Accusative case.

cases.sentence: В нынешнем же году назначены были офицерские скачки с ___.
cases.translation: That year, officers' steeplechase races with obstacles had been scheduled.
cases.explain: The preposition «с» (with) governs the Instrumental case, hence «препятствиями».

cases.sentence: молодые люди завидовали ему... в высоком ___ Каренина.
cases.translation: young men envied him ... in Karenin's high position
cases.explain: The preposition «в» (in) denoting status governs the Prepositional case, hence «положении».

reading.ru: Полковые интересы занимали важное место в жизни Вронского и потому, что он любил полк, и еще более потому, что его любили в полку.
reading.question: Why did regimental interests matter so much to Vronsky?
options: Because he loved the regiment and was loved in it
Because he had no other friends
reading.correct: Because he loved the regiment and was loved in it
reading.explain: The text says regimental interests were important to him both because he loved the regiment and because he was loved in it.

reading.ru: В полку не только любили Вронского, но его уважали и гордились им.
reading.question: How did the regiment feel about Vronsky?
options: They loved, respected, and were proud of him
reading.correct: They loved, respected, and were proud of him
reading.explain: The text states the regiment not only loved Vronsky but respected him and took pride in him.

reading.ru: Большинство молодых женщин, завидовавших Анне, которым уже давно наскучило то, что ее называют справедливою, радовались тому, что они предполагали, и ждали только подтверждения оборота общественного мнения, чтобы обрушиться на нее всею тяжестью своего презрения.
reading.question: What were most young women who envied Anna waiting for?
options: Confirmation of a shift in public opinion so they could attack her with contempt
reading.correct: Confirmation of a shift in public opinion so they could attack her with contempt
reading.explain: The text says these women were only waiting for confirmation that public opinion had turned so they could unleash their contempt on Anna.

reading.ru: Мать Вронского, узнав о его связи, сначала была довольна.
reading.question: How did Vronsky's mother initially react to learning of his affair?
reading.explain: The text says Vronsky's mother, upon learning of his affair, was at first pleased.

reading.ru: Но в последнее время она узнала, что сын отказался от предложенного ему важного для карьеры положения только с тем, чтобы оставаться в полку, где он мог видеться с Карениной.
reading.question: Why did the mother's opinion change?
options: She learned he had refused an important career position just to stay near Karenina
She learned he had lost money gambling
She learned Anna was married to someone else
She learned he wanted to leave the regiment
reading.correct: She learned he had refused an important career position just to stay near Karenina
reading.explain: She discovered that her son had turned down an important career position only so he could stay in the regiment near Karenina.

reading.ru: Старший брат был также недоволен меньшим.
reading.question: How did Vronsky's older brother feel about the affair?
options: He was also displeased with his younger brother
reading.correct: He was also displeased with his younger brother
reading.explain: The text says the elder brother was also displeased with the younger one.

reading.ru: Кроме занятий службы и света, у Вронского было еще занятие – лошади, до которых он был страстный охотник.
reading.question: Besides his career and social life, what was Vronsky passionate about?
reading.explain: The text states that besides his service and society life, Vronsky had another passion: horses.

reading.ru: Вронский записался на скачки, купил английскую кровную кобылу и, несмотря на свою любовь, был страстно, хотя и сдержанно, увлечен предстоящими скачками.
reading.question: What did Vronsky do in preparation for the officers' steeplechase?
options: He entered the race and bought an English thoroughbred mare
reading.correct: He entered the race and bought an English thoroughbred mare
reading.explain: The text says Vronsky signed up for the race and bought an English thoroughbred mare, becoming passionately absorbed in the upcoming race.
